items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: Well, they had Joseph Phillip, Roy Lonnie Johnson. Well, they had a lot more of them, but didn't compare with them, see.

ctx.x: How many blues pickers did they have out there, you say, around your neighborhood? Just get to them.

Well, they had Joseph Phillip, Roy Lonnie Johnson. Well, they had a lot more of them, but didn't compare with them, see. It was right smart to get to our players. You could see guys walking them down, the liver would get down on the shoulder all the time. You want me to get in touch with Joseph Phillip?
